the cultivation of physical teachers in China should be innovated from the following aspects: the cultivation of physical educators should be innovated in systems,modes and contents; the on-the-job education of physical teachers should be innovated;the institutions for the cultivation of physical educator should be innovated,and the cultivation of physical teacher should be innovated.

there are many problems currently existing in China in the cultivation of the physical education teachers,which are the result of the lack of the innovation in systems, modes,contents, means, institutions and management.
